scope: TX source preparation + pure-digital verification ONLY. No RX/mode/model/common-frame/two-DC/bitstream changes. No RF_PASS claimed.

radio_pluto_link_probe.role: Radio.send int16 rule (round->int16->x16, I/Q interleaved LE), scan_usb, set/get/stop/close

amplitude_plan.int16_rule: round(component) -> int16 -> x16, I/Q interleaved little-endian

threshold_justification.recovery_corr: discriminator: correct offset sign recovers ~0.99+; wrong sign/resample -> ~0 (signal moved 2x off-center and filtered out)
threshold_justification.image_suppression: first +2.56 MHz image sits in the anti-imaging filter transition band because the source uses full Nyquist; a working 81-tap Kaiser filter gives ~25-30 dBc (measured -28.3/-29.2 dB), a missing filter ~0 dBc; >=20 dBc discriminates filter-present vs filter-absent
threshold_justification.guard_suppression: signals 3.6 MHz apart, 2.56 MHz occupancy, 1.04 MHz gap; skirts must be >20 dB down at mid-gap
threshold_justification.quant_snr: int16 step 16 -> error var 256/12; 40 dB is conservative
threshold_justification.wrap: frame starts/ends with 2048 zeros so the cyclic DDS wrap is perfectly continuous (d=0)

known_limitations: image (first +2.56 MHz sampling replica) is ~-28 dBc, NOT -60 dBc: the source occupies the full Nyquist so the replica's inner edge lands on the anti-imaging filter cutoff; this is a REAL spur consistent with the RX's reported +/-2.56 MHz aliases and must be watched on the board (spectrum analyzer or raw-IQ)
the offline verification is pure-digital; it does NOT prove RF radiation or spectrum purity on real hardware
